items.Sentence: The treatment process consists of preliminary screening (two fine bar screens and one coarse bar screen), grit removal (two vortex -type grit removal devices), influent flow equalization (two tanks with a maximum combined volume of 1.2 million gallons), primary sedimentation (two primary clarifiers), biological activated sludge treatment (two aeration basins), secondary clarification (two secondary clarifiers), and sodium hypochlorite disinfection.
